title: AnimatablePair & VectorArithmetic
hints: Interpolation is `a + (b - a) × t`, written with `VectorArithmetic` operations.
`scale(by:)` is mutating, so copy the delta into a `var` first.
`var delta = b - a; delta.scale(by: t); return a + delta`.
jsBridge: `AnimatablePair<A, B>` bundles two animatable values via `VectorArithmetic` (`+`, `-`, `scale(by:)`). Interpolation is vector maths, the same as interpolating `{x, y}` objects in a JS tween library.
